Autumn, 2024

Best nearby place to hitchhike in direction Wien. Started 9 am on a Friday. Make sure to stand along the highway, as you'll have a much better chance than if you stand within the gas station. The guy who picked me up said he saw hitchhikers 30 meters or so in front of me (which you can see as a pin on hitchmap), but he wouldn't have been able to pick them up, as it was hard to stop. So hitch from here!!

There's many rest stops on this road, and I'm not sure which one I was dropped off at because my ride did not speak any english, but I got extremely lucky and was dropped off literally in front of another ride (Romanian) that at first drove me to Budapest and then accepted to take me all the way to Arad, Romania. This is extreme luck on my behalf though, so be careful with these rest stops, they can be hit or miss. Stop at a petrol station up ahead (ask for "benzinkút") or at the Austrian/ Hunga

I have the same experiment as the previous comment said. This is not a good place if you want to leave Szeged at noon. I suggest the next bus stop in front of the Nagybani piac at the roundabouts by the highway, but hard to say. In the morning you could get a better chance to have a lift from here. (anyway the bus stop is near the Budapesti út, the point suggest a forest road, so you have to stay at the "Nyári tanya" bus stop)

This was the second time I hitched here and was terrible. We waited 2 hours with my girlfriend trying to get a ride towards Budapest on a Thursday afternoon. As we ran out of time, decided to take the bus. Lots of cars passing, but the ones who stopped for us were going to villages nearby. Maybe the problem was that we didn't have a sign. I don't know, because the other time this spot worked really well.
